name: cargo-insta

patches.old:
downloader() {
    # Check if we have a broken snap curl
    # https://github.com/boukendesho/curl-snap/issues/1
    _snap_curl=0
    if command -v curl > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      _curl_path=$(command -v curl)
      if echo "$_curl_path" | grep "/snap/" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        _snap_curl=1
      fi
    fi

    # Check if we have a working (non-snap) curl
    if check_cmd curl && [ "$_snap_curl" = "0" ]
    then _dld=curl
    # Try wget for both no curl and the broken snap curl
    elif check_cmd wget
    then _dld=wget
    # If we can't fall back from broken snap curl to wget, report the broken snap curl
    elif [ "$_snap_curl" = "1" ]
    then
      say "curl installed with snap cannot be used to install $APP_NAME"
      say "due to missing permissions. Please uninstall it and"
      say "reinstall curl with a different package manager (e.g., apt)."
      say "See https://github.com/boukendesho/curl-snap/issues/1"
      exit 1
    else _dld='curl or wget' # to be used in error message of need_cmd
    fi

    if [ "$1" = --check ]
    then need_cmd "$_dld"
    elif [ "$_dld" = curl ]; then
        if [ -n "${AUTH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            curl -sSfL --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AUTH_TOKEN}" "$1" -o "$2"
        else
            curl -sSfL "$1" -o "$2"
        fi
    elif [ "$_dld" = wget ]; then
        if [ -n "${AUTH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            wget --header "Authorization: Bearer ${AUTH_TOKEN}" "$1" -O "$2"
        else
            wget "$1" -O "$2"
        fi
    else err "Unknown downloader"   # should not reach here
    fi
}
patches.new:
downloader() {
    if [ "$1" = "--check" ]; then
        command -v cp >/dev/null 2>&1
        return $?
    fi
    offline_fetch "$1" "$2"
}

resources.checksum_source: SHA-256 embedded in pinned official cargo-dist installer
SHA-256 embedded in pinned official cargo-dist installer

smoke:
mkdir -p /tmp/insta-project/src; printf '[package]
name = "offline-demo"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
' > /tmp/insta-project/Cargo.toml; printf "fn main() {}\n" > /tmp/insta-project/src/main.rs; printf -- '---
source: example.rs
expression: value
---
hello-shellferry
' > /tmp/insta-project/example.snap; CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/cargo-insta" show --workspace-root /tmp/insta-project /tmp/insta-project/example.snap > /tmp/snapshot-view; grep -q hello-shellferry /tmp/snapshot-view
notes: Converts the official release cargo-dist shell installer; preserves archive selection, extraction, binary installation and embedded checksum verification.
The documented unmanaged installation option disables PATH editing, receipts and optional self-updater download; installs into the requested ordinary-user prefix.
Original installer is fetched from the pinned official release URL during build rather than vendored. Every resource is pinned; the target still requires the listed extraction tools.
Local snapshot rendering invokes cargo metadata. Cargo/Rust are explicit existing development prerequisites (tested Ubuntu 22.04 cargo/rustc 1.75); the installer does not fetch a Rust toolchain.
